'''Ansan Talam''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was one of the first [[Miner/Legends|miners]] to arrive on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. Independent and liking space and solitude, Talam prospected in unexplored craters for [[Tasar crystal]]s. While he rarely found rich deposits, Talam occasionally hit it big but sold off his claim before the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] corporations moved in.<ref name="J15" />

Talam was an ardent supporter of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], and a diehard [[Speciesism|racist]] to non-Humans. Much of the wealth that Talam earned over the years was donated to the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]. He had been a member since the organization was first founded, and believed it was a grassroots movement created by the people of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] for the benefit of the people of the Empire. Talam's racism extended to his equipment, frequently paying more for imported goods rather than using the [[Tasari]]'s own products. His only concession was owning an [[All Terrain Cruiser K-111]] [[steam rover]] which replaced a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] lost in a [[Tunnel worm (Tasariq)|tunnel worm]] attack.<ref name="J15" />

During his time on Tasariq, Talam came into possession of a [[citrine crystal]] that granted him the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] of [[Accelerate Healing]].<ref name="J15" />
